copy.title: Settings
copy.intro: Choices are stored on this device and shared across windows.
copy.languageHelp: Applies to every window after switching.
copy.namingHelp: Changes the suggested name in the save dialog only.
copy.recoveryHelp: Off by default. Saves private copies of images, masks and committed edits on this device; turning it off removes them.
copy.unavailable: Settings can only be saved in the desktop app.
copy.shellCompletionHelp: After processing: choose how to view results. Errors always provide a recovery prompt.
copy.shellMenusHelp: Requires confirmation. macOS can enable or remove Finder actions here; Windows uses the installer checkbox.
copy.shellInstallerHelp: Run the Windows installer again and confirm the right-click checkbox, or clear it to disable the actions.

extra.privacyBody: Images, filenames, paths, masks and edits stay on this device. Network access is used for declared model downloads and license links you open.
extra.qualityBody: Uses pinned IS-Net, MobileSAM and ViTMatte FP32. CPU fallback keeps the same weights and input size.
extra.formatHelp: Transparent PNG at original dimensions; inference uses the model input size.
extra.clearHelp: Only clears session copies in the app’s private folder. Exported PNGs and cached models stay in place.
extra.preview: Settings are read-only in browser preview.
